mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime with unemployment below 4.0% and monthly job growth exceeding 0.5%, wage pressures drive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC for joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rises above 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances where HOUST increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) signal restrictive monetary policy combined with supply contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of rising FEDFUNDS and declining INDPRO fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017 base index), it indicates manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
